items.description: A custom MacOS keyboard layout for Persian (Farsi) typists who want Latin digits (0–9) instead of Persian digits (۰–۹) when typing numbers, while keeping the standard ISIRI 9147 Persian letter layout untouched.
items.readme_snippet:
# MacOS Persian Keyboard with Latin Numbers

A custom MacOS keyboard layout for Persian (Farsi) typists who want **Latin digits (0–9)** instead of Persian digits (۰–۹) when typing numbers, while keeping the standard ISIRI 9147 Persian letter layout untouched.

## Why

macOS's built-in Persian keyboard (and most Persian layouts in general) types Persian numerals (۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹) by default on the number row. This is often undesirable when working with code, URLs, dates, prices, or any mixed Persian/English content where Latin digits are expected.

## What this layout changes

Based on  [`Persian-PC` layout by Fardjad Davari](https://github.com/fardjad/persian-pc.keylayout) (Windows-style Persian layout, ISIRI 9147 standard), with the following modification:

| Key | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Number row (no Shift) | ۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹ | `0123456789` |
| Number row + Shift | `!@#$%^&*()` etc. | **unchanged** |
| Numeric keypad | ۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹ | `0123456789` |
| All Persian letters | ISIRI 9147 |

# datahandler

Lightweight pandas utilities for cleaning messy DataFrames and generating quick data profiles — no dependencies beyond `pandas` and `numpy`.

## 🎯 What does this library do?

In countries like Iran where `api.telegram.org` is network-filtered, developers need a VPN or a foreign server to run their Telegram bots.

**andro-cfw** solves this with a simple trick: it deploys a Cloudflare Worker as a reverse proxy between your bot and Telegram:


```
Your Bot (Python / JS / PHP)  ←→  Cloudflare Worker (unfiltered)  ←→  api.telegram.org
```

Cloudflare's edge network is reachable from restricted regions even when Telegram's API is not, so your bot talks to the Worker and the Worker talks to Telegram.

An agent skill that audits any codebase and writes implementation plans for other agents to execute.

The idea: use your most capable model for the part where intelligence compounds — understanding the codebase, judging what's worth doing, writing the spec — and hand execution to cheaper models. The skill never implements anything itself. The plan is the product.

you          →  /improve                    (expensive model, advises)
plans/       →  001-fix-n-plus-one.md       (self-contained specs)
other agent  →  implements, tests, ships    (cheap model, executes)

npx skills add shadcn/improve
